Analyses of measured fishes, exported as a reproducible project

Source: R/launch_intrait_analyses.R
launch_intrait_analyses.Rd

Opens a Shiny application for the ANALYSIS part of the intraitR workflow, on specimens already measured: FISHMORPH traits, functional trait space and dispersion tests, position in the global FISHMORPH space, intraspecific variability (variance partition, coefficients of variation, sampling effort), shape space, measurement error. Each tab shows the result live; the Export tab writes the whole analysis as a project with the architecture of a published paper – numbered scripts, data, results, run_all.R, README, and a Methods & Results report – by running the project's own scripts, then zips it (see write_analysis_project()).

Usage

launch_intrait_analyses(
  xlsx_path = NULL,
  specimens = NULL,
  landmarks = NULL,
  literature = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  author = NULL,
  launch.browser = TRUE,
  port = NULL,
  host = "127.0.0.1",
  ...
)

Arguments

xlsx_path

A digitizer workbook (sheet measurements; a bias sheet, when present, gives the repeated digitizations for measurement error). Landmarks are read up to point 25, so that the hinges of curved specimens count in standard length.

specimens

Optional table of the specimens (a data.frame or the path of a CSV file): column specimen (the workbook's identifier) and any of species, site, date, operator. It overrides the workbook's own columns and restricts the analysis to the specimens it lists.

landmarks

Alternatively, an "intrait_landmarks" object (or the path of an .rds file holding one), metadata with species.

literature

Optional individual trait records without photographs (a data.frame or the path of a CSV file): species, the nine FISHMORPH ratios, and optionally specimen_code, site, date, study_id. They enter the analyses based on the ratios, with the provenance "literature"; the hub passes those of its Results filters.

title, author

Pre-filled title and author of the exported project.

launch.browser, port, host

Passed to shiny::runApp().

...

Other arguments for shiny::runApp().

Value

Called for its side effect; the app's value when it closes.

Details

The measurement hub (launch_measure_hub()) opens it from its Results tab on the measured specimens of the chosen scope.

See also

write_analysis_project(), analysis_params()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
launch_intrait_analyses(xlsx_path = "T26_landmarks.xlsx")
} # }
